commonAuthoritySchema.taskExecutionAuthorizedRule: True only for the exact currently authorized boundary control record; false for every later child until a separate instruction and committed predecessor.

decisionEligibility.prerequisite: Any authenticated committed B131-1 pass or fail may reach O131-0 after a new operator instruction.

digestFraming.framing: Exact canonical UTF-8 file bytes including exactly one final LF.
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL, then for each of seven ordered members: POSIX filename UTF-8 || NUL || exact member bytes || NUL
Exact candidate-manifest bytes including final LF; manifest excludes itself.
Exact frozen-semantic-target bytes including final LF; target binds candidate manifest and does not hash itself.
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL || canonical report JSON without final LF and without the declared stored digest field
literal domain UTF-8 including NUL || canonical compact JSON encoding of exactly one JSON value without final LF

retryRules.afterCommit: Immutable; create a new additive attempt/task/commit.
retryRules.beforeCommit: Only exact task-local scratch may be corrected or individually removed; no broad clean/reset/stash.
retryRules.failedAssurance: May proceed only to reject/stop or a separately authorized additive author/assurance attempt; never repair A131-1.

roleSeparation.assurance: Reads exact immutable A131-1 Git subject; executes assurance; no repair.
roleSeparation.author: Authors candidate and author evidence only.
roleSeparation.governance: Pins topology, inventories, semantics, containment, and validation only.
roleSeparation.operator: Records one later genuine decision only.

terminalBoundary: STOP after O131-1. Acceptance authorizes semantic-contract authority only for a separately governed future technical campaign.
